safety.text: Inferred: AtomWallet should enforce validUntil and validAfter constraints so that a UserOperation cannot be executed outside its intended validity period.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.
evidence: When verifying the signature of `UserOperation`, `EntryPoint` will check returned `validAfter` and `validUntil`. The `UserOperation` can not be executed if the valid period is expired. The following is the calling process in [`EntryPoint`](https://github.com/eth-infinitism/account-abstraction/blob/cc3893bcaf2272c163ce89d5eb9eadb8e6b52db7/contracts/core/EntryPoint.sol#L58-L76):

However, Both `validUntil` and `validAfter` can be manipulated, the AtomWallet fails to enforce validUntil and validAfter constraints, permitting the execution of UserOperations outside of their intended validity period.
The root cause is that `validUntil` and `validAfter` are excluded from the UserOperation signature hash. Consequently, these values can be modified without invalidating the signature.

effects.text: UserOperations are executed outside of their intended validity period because AtomWallet fails to enforce validUntil and validAfter constraints.
